scope: Read-only review of seven existing UOS native/facade files, existing candidate-comparison documents, and public versioned upstream metadata. No external source code or binaries were imported.

observed_code_findings.finding: Fallback open returns a fresh reference and put returns ok without a native operation; open also logs the supplied configuration. Replace phantom success and avoid logging possible credentials.
Unloaded get returns an empty JSON array and close reports closed; these outputs do not establish native execution.
Native loading consults hardcoded external C3I shared-library paths. Admission requires a UOS-owned, exact build and ABI receipt.
Get errors are inferred from the substring error in returned data; legitimate payloads can be rejected. Structured native result decoding is required.

Global OnceCell session set errors are ignored; close clears the inner Option but subsequent open cannot replace the cell. Network work holds a global mutex across awaits, and status may block on that mutex on a normal scheduler.
Invalid JSON becomes a default configuration, only a partial connect configuration is applied, and status reports a fixed endpoint.
Publication accepts String rather than arbitrary bytes; received bytes undergo lossy UTF-8 conversion, and error replies are discarded.

Five inspected exports do not implement the required subscription, queryable, liveliness, advanced extension and ecosystem capability families. This preparation does not count every missing upstream API item.
